name: learn_01_spawn
title: Single spawn (Y=10)
expected: Player spawns at center, stands on flat floor, no fall-through.

name: learn_02_four_spawns
title: Four corner spawns
expected: Quick-team places up to four players at corners (±1500).

name: learn_03_weapon
title: Floor weapon pickup
expected: CMP150 (or configured weapon) visible at map center; pickup works.

name: learn_04_ammo
title: Ammo crate
expected: Ammo crate at +X; picking up refills matching ammo type.

name: learn_05_loadout
title: Loadout intro / ailist 0x1000
expected: Combat start: default loadout weapons (Falcon2, CMP150, …) in hand.

name: learn_06_waypoints
title: Symmetric waypoints / bot spawn
expected: Add 1–4 simulants in Combat Simulator; bots move without crashing.

name: learn_07_hill
title: King of the Hill anchor
expected: Launch with --scenario-4; green hill zone at +Z with dark ring boundary; KOTH scoring only inside hill room.

name: learn_08_ctf_case
title: Case + CaseRespawn (CTF pair)
expected: Launch with --scenario-5; briefcase at -Z, respawn at +Z (team 0). Bright red delivery square + dark ring at +Z (CaseRespawn); muted red marker at -Z (Case). Steal enemy case and touch home pad to score instantly. No hold countdown (that is --scenario-1 Hold Briefcase only).

name: learn_09_deploy_uff
title: Deploy-as uff / --test-map slot
expected: Same empty box; confirms play-learn-step deploys into uff test slot.

name: learn_10_full_arena
title: Composite (my_arena-like)
expected: Launch with --scenario-5 (Capture the Case). Grey arena floor; small coloured squares only at CTF pads (seg mode ctf). Enemy briefcase at -Z (team 1 Case, muted yellow square + ring). Walk north to -Z, pick up the briefcase, return south to +Z and stand on the bright red delivery square (team 0 CaseRespawn) — scoring triggers when you touch your home Case prop at +Z while holding the enemy case. After a score (or if the carrier is killed), each briefcase warps back to its own Case pad (team 1 → -Z yellow, team 0 → +Z red). KOTH hill at +X (room 2).

name: learn_11_y_autocorrect
title: Pad Y auto-correction (Y=0 → 10)
expected: Player still spawns safely despite JSON Y=0 on pad (pipeline fix).

name: learn_12_testarena_fixture
title: Registered testarena layout (minimal_map.json)
expected: Launch with --scenario-5. Layout matches registered STAGE_TESTARENA / minimal_map.json fixture (four spawns, weapon, ammo, hill, 4× Case pairs). Combat Sim menu shows 'Test Arena' label (textid 0x7FFC) when played from menu — manual.

name: learn_13_fixture_compact
title: Compact fixture (minimal_map 2.json)
expected: Launch with --scenario-4; hill at +Z; weapon/ammo pickups work in 5000 box.

name: learn_14_procedural_seg
title: Procedural box seg (PDMAP_SEG_MODE=full)
expected: Build with --seg-mode full: visible box walls from procedural generator. Collision still from tiles; seg is visual. May show near-plane clip in FPS — contrast with step 15 empty mode.

name: learn_15_seg_empty
title: Empty seg mode (PDMAP_SEG_MODE=empty)
expected: Launch with --seg-mode empty: no visible seg walls; flat grey floor from tiles only.

name: learn_16_my_arena_registered
title: Registered my_arena layout
expected: Launch with --scenario-5. Layout matches registered STAGE_MY_ARENA. Combat Sim menu shows 'My Arena' (textid 0x7FFD) when played from menu — manual.

name: learn_17_from_json_cli
title: from-json CLI canonical path
expected: Same spawn box; validates via from-json → build_from_spec without level module edits.

name: learn_18_register_scratch
title: Registration probe target (learn_scratch pattern)
expected: Automated: pdmap register --apply learn_scratch dry-run passes (probe_register_apply_e2e). Live stage registration requires make rebuild — manual smoke only.

name: learn_19_hold_briefcase
title: Hold the Briefcase (scenario 1)
expected: Launch with --scenario-1. Pick up briefcase; green 30s countdown while holding; score on timer expiry. No CTF Case/CaseRespawn pads required.

name: learn_20_overlap_pads
title: Cross-type pad overlap (spawn + weapon + ammo)
expected: Launch with --scenario-0. Marker seg (grey floor, no walls): bright green centre square (~5 m) marks the overlap point. Player spawns on that square with AR34 pickup and shotgun ammo crate at the same spot — look down at your feet; all three function (stock uff pattern).

name: learn_21_hacker_central
title: Hacker Central (scenario 2)
expected: Launch with --scenario-2. Two multi-ammo crates feed the HTM bank; terminal (MODEL_GOODPC) stands upright on floor pads (up=+Y). Pick up Data Uplink, interact with terminal — download progress bar runs ~20s.

name: learn_22_pop_a_cap
title: Pop a Cap (scenario 3)
expected: Launch with --scenario-3. Solo (--num-sims 0): you are always the victim — green 1:00 countdown at top center is the survival timer (+1 point each minute alive; not match start, kill limit, or time limit). Pop-a-cap scoring works with spawns only — no special pads.

name: learn_23_bot_four_cap
title: Bot count cap (stock 4 simulants)
expected: Launch with --scenario-0 --num-sims 8. Only 4 bots spawn (stock MP cap without MPFEATURE_8BOTS). Bots pathfind without crash.

name: learn_24_mpweapon_loadout
title: MPWEAPON CLI loadout namespace
expected: Launch with --scenario-0 --loadout 1,9,16,4,0,37. Starting weapons: Falcon2, CMP150, AR34, MagSec4, empty, Shield (MPWEAPON space — distinct from floor weaponnum 0x11 for AR34 props in learn_03_weapon).

name: learn_25_boot_stage
title: Boot registered stage (my_arena)
expected: Manual: build+deploy my_arena assets, then ./build/pd.arm64 --boot-stage STAGE_MY_ARENA --skip-intro --moddir mods/mod_allinone --scenario-5. Loads bg_my_arena.* (not uff test slot).

name: learn_26_solo_ctf
title: Solo human CTF (no simulants)
expected: Launch with --scenario-5 --num-sims 0. Human-only: pick up case at -Z, return to +Z CaseRespawn; instant score without bots.

name: learn_27_multi_weapon
title: Multiple floor weapons (weaponnum namespace)
expected: Launch with --scenario-0. Three floor pickups at -X, center, +X each grant the correct weapon (weaponnum space — contrast learn_24 MPWEAPON loadout).

name: learn_28_hill_collision
title: Hill room-1 collision mirror (no fall-through)
expected: Launch with --scenario-4. Walk the dark ring boundary around the green hill square at +Z — floor solid everywhere; no void fall-through at hill edge.

name: learn_29_custom_seg_script
title: Custom SEG_SCRIPT seg generator
expected: Build with level module SEG_SCRIPT (not procedural-only). Visible box seg from scripts/learn_29_seg_build.py; G_VTX loads ≤16; no relinkPtr crash. Walk to each coloured wall — solid perimeter collision (tiles), not seg geometry.

name: learn_30_mod_hygiene
title: Deploy hygiene / external asset load
expected: Launch with --scenario-0. stderr/log shows bg_uff tiles/pads/seg/setup 'loaded externally' from mods/mod_allinone (not ROM embedded). Re-deploy after every edit — stale assets cause silent regressions.

name: learn_31_cover_points
title: AI cover points (add_cover)
expected: Launch with --scenario-0 --num-sims 2. Two cover points at X=±800; bright green floor squares (~5 m) with dark rings mark each cover pad (same style as step 20 centre marker). Bots spawn at ±X=2000 and pathfind; cover behaviour is AI-only — markers are visual only.
